Package com.example.cab302assignment.model

Class RiskAnalysis

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302assignment.model.RiskAnalysis
public class RiskAnalysis extends Object
Model representing the outcome of a risk analysis run against a single user prompt.

A RiskAnalysis captures the overall RiskLevel, a numerical score, a human-readable summary, a breakdown of detected SensitiveDataType occurrences in typeCounts, and the timestamp at which the analysis was performed.

Instances are typically produced by the analysis pipeline and persisted via a RiskAnalysisDAO; they are then aggregated into a UserRiskScore for display in the profile and dashboards.

  • Constructor Details

    • RiskAnalysis

      public RiskAnalysis()
      Creates an empty RiskAnalysis.

      Provided primarily for frameworks (JavaBeans, DAOs) that construct the instance and then populate it through setters.

    • RiskAnalysis

      public RiskAnalysis(int promptId, RiskLevel riskLevel, double score, String summary, Map<SensitiveDataType,Integer> typeCounts, LocalDateTime analysedAt)
      Creates a fully populated RiskAnalysis.

      The analysisId is not set by this constructor and is expected to be assigned by the persistence layer.

      Parameters:
      promptId - identifier of the prompt that was analysed
      riskLevel - the categorical risk level assigned to the prompt
      score - the numerical risk score
      summary - a human-readable summary of the analysis
      typeCounts - counts of each sensitive data type detected; may be null, in which case the internal map remains empty
      analysedAt - the timestamp at which the analysis was performed

      public void setTypeCounts(Map<SensitiveDataType,Integer> typeCounts)
      Replaces the per-type sensitive data counts.

      If typeCounts is null, the internal map is reset to an empty EnumMap; otherwise the supplied map is adopted directly.
